archetypes.name: reference-traceability
archetypes.rationale: The plan is a documentation-restoration with heavy reliance on specific citations (NEVER #5/#14/#15, three entry-point locations, helper contracts) that must resolve against current SKILL.md and repo files — citation drift is the primary defect mode for this class of plan.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan makes specific claims about the location and content of NEVER #5, NEVER #14, NEVER #15, the three Step 9a.1 entry points (Exit 0 OOS branch, OOS checkpoint block, Python oos-filing dispatch), and helper contracts in oos-disposition-gate.md and oos-non-security-block-count.awk. Verify that every NEVER entry, step citation, and helper reference the plan relies on actually exists in skills/implement/SKILL.md and the referenced script files at the locations and in the form the plan describes. Check whether the step numbering scheme (3.4, 3.4b) the plan promises to restore would actually satisfy the existing SKILL.md step 3.4 / step 3.4b citations, and that the three entry-point wiring locations exist as described. Identify any citation the plan makes against current repo content that is absent or materially different from the plan's characterization, since such a gap would cause the implementation to diverge from the plan without warning. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: guard-efficacy
archetypes.rationale: The regression guard (11 CI assertions in test-implement-structure.sh) is the key delta vs prior fix #1886 — the silent third recurrence shows the prior guard was missing; evaluating whether the planned assertions are specific, non-gameable, and complete against the listed failure modes is the highest-value correctness check for this plan.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan proposes 11 numbered CI assertions in scripts/test-implement-structure.sh as the durable regression guard; evaluate each: is the fixed-string fragment specific enough to avoid false positives (matching a comment, unrelated prose, or wrong file), and would silently removing the guarded feature actually fail the assertion? Check whether assertions 8b and 9 — which require detecting that run-statistics is absent from the sentinel-recovery branch and that ISSUES_FAILED suppresses gate-visible URL appends — are actually testable by static grep against the proposed file structure, or whether they require behavioral inference a grep cannot provide. Identify any failure mode listed in the plan's Failure modes section that has no corresponding assertion in the test plan, paying special attention to manifest harvest (oos_observations[]), security-routing predicate alignment, and all-deduplicated disposition coverage. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
